sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

decisions.tactician: The two-year options cost us about the same and far less than the twelve-month ones (o8, o9). Among the sixty-day, two-year options (E0, o2, o3, o4), our cost is identical, but a later effective date is a concession to the supplier at no cost to us. o2 offers it a month of the old price without our C rising, so it is a mild goodwill signal. That makes o2 better than E0 as an opening. Holding the date change back keeps o3 and o4 as later give-aways. The price stays just under the health price, leaving room to concede toward it. Opening at today's price does not take its first offer.

decisions.tactician: E0 gives the supplier exactly the structure it asked for: 45-day payment, 24 months and the January start. Its value to the supplier is the same as o1-o4, and our C is within a few hundred euros of theirs. Granting the requested payment term is the cooperative signal that makes acceptance or a small counter likely. The 30-day options would reopen payment after it asked to settle at 45 days. Going lower toward the health price risks friction, and the relationship charge means pushing much further gains little. At its recent pace, about one more reply should reach this level, so we do not accept the standing sheets yet.

decisions.tactician: The supplier is still conceding at a steady pace and has not said this is its last word, so accepting DEMO-F1-2 (C €418,911) would leave value on the table. o3 and o4 give the lowest C, about €410,130, slightly below E0's €410,302. Both are worth the same to the supplier as E0 and stay above the health price, so they do not trigger relationship charges. Offering faster payment is a concession it can see in its own cash value, which helps it accept. I chose o3 over o4 because the February start date is less of a departure from the 1 January date it has already agreed than an April start would be.
